mapper.select: SELECT * FROM t_zgsq_guan_lang WHERE guan_lang_no = #{guanLangNo} AND deleted = 0 LIMIT 1

SELECT COALESCE(MAX(CAST( SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(guan_lang_no, '-', 3), '-', -1) AS UNSIGNED )), 0) FROM t_zgsq_guan_lang WHERE guan_lang_no LIKE CONCAT('GL-', #{cityName}, '-%') AND deleted = 0

SELECT * FROM t_zgsq_guan_lang WHERE deleted = 0 AND gis_coord IS NOT NULL -- 经度粗过滤：SUBSTRING_INDEX("[116.4,39.9]", ",", 1) = 116.4 AND CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING(gis_coord, 2), ',', 1) AS DECIMAL(10,6)) BETWEEN #{minLon} AND #{maxLon} -- 纬度粗过滤 AND CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING(gis_coord, 2), ',', -1) AS DECIMAL(10,6)) BETWEEN #{minLat} AND #{maxLat} ORDER BY guan_lang_id DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_zgsq_guan_lang WHERE deleted = 0
AND guan_lang_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{guanLangNo}, '%')
AND guan_lang_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{guanLangName}, '%')
AND guan_lang_status = #{guanLangStatus}
AND belong_district LIKE CONCAT('%', #{belongDistrict}, '%')
